stem:
Ishaan works one integer worksheet that mixes number-line moves, token debts and credits, and written signed numbers.

Which claim correctly describes the operations on that worksheet?

options.text: Only the number-line moves count as integer practice on the worksheet.
Using one shared operation system is what creates the number-line moves, tokens, and signed numbers.
The same addition and subtraction rules apply to the number-line moves, the tokens, and the signed numbers.
Subtraction of integers on the worksheet follows a separate rule from adding the opposite integer.

teacher.key_rationale: Mixed integer representations share one signed-number operation system. Number-line, tokens, and written signs are not separate rule sets, and rewriting subtraction as adding the opposite is part of that same system.
